#ifndef ZEPHYR_TESTSUITE_ZTEST_TEST_H_
#define ZEPHYR_TESTSUITE_ZTEST_TEST_H_

#include <zephyr/kernel.h>
#include <zephyr/sys/iterable_sections.h>

#ifdef __cplusplus
extern "C" {
#endif

struct ztest_unit_test {
	const char *name;
	void (*test)(void);
	void (*setup)(void);
	void (*teardown)(void);
};

struct ztest_suite_node {
	const char *name;
	const struct ztest_unit_test *unit_tests;
	bool has_run;
	void (*suite_setup)(void);
	void (*suite_teardown)(void);
	void (*before)(void *data);
	void (*after)(void *data);
};

/**
 * @defgroup ztest_test Ztest testing macros
 * @ingroup ztest
 *
 * This module provides the ztest testing framework.
 *
 * @{
 */

/**
 * @brief Define a test case.
 *
 * @param fn Function name for the test case.
 */
#define ztest_unit_test(fn) \
	{ \
		.name = #fn, \
		.test = fn, \
		.setup = NULL, \
		.teardown = NULL, \
	}

/**
 * @brief Define a test case with setup and teardown functions.
 *
 * @param fn Function name for the test case.
 * @param setup Function to run before the test case.
 * @param teardown Function to run after the test case.
 */
#define ztest_unit_test_setup_teardown(fn, setup, teardown) \
	{ \
		.name = #fn, \
		.test = fn, \
		.setup = setup, \
		.teardown = teardown, \
	}

/**
 * @brief Define a test suite.
 *
 * @param suite Name of the test suite.
 * @param ... List of test cases.
 */
#define ztest_test_suite(suite, ...) \
	static const Z_STRUCT_SECTION_ITERABLE(ztest_suite_node, suite##_suite_node) = { \
		.name = #suite, \
		.unit_tests = (const struct ztest_unit_test[]){\
			__VA_ARGS__, \
			{ 0 } \
		}, \
	}

/**
 * @brief Define a test suite with a setup and teardown functions.
 *
 * @param suite Name of the test suite.
 * @param suite_setup Function to run before the test suite.
 * @param suite_teardown Function to run after the test suite.
 * @param ... List of test cases.
 */
#define ztest_test_suite_with_setup_teardown(suite, suite_setup, suite_teardown, ...) \
	static const Z_STRUCT_SECTION_ITERABLE(ztest_suite_node, suite##_suite_node) = { \
		.name = #suite, \
		.unit_tests = (const struct ztest_unit_test[]){\
			__VA_ARGS__, \
			{ 0 } \
		}, \
		.suite_setup = suite_setup, \
		.suite_teardown = suite_teardown, \
	}

/**

# Kconfig - settings subsystem
#
# Copyright (c) 2018-2021 Nordic Semiconductor ASA
#
# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
#

menu "Settings"

config SETTINGS
	bool "Enable settings subsystem"
	help
	  Enable settings subsystem. This provides a way to store
	  key-value pairs persistently.

if SETTINGS

config SETTINGS_LOG_LEVEL_OFF
	bool "Off"
	help
	  Do not write any log messages.

config SETTINGS_LOG_LEVEL_ERR
	bool "Error"
	help
	  Write only error messages.

config SETTINGS_LOG_LEVEL_WRN
	bool "Warning"
	help
	  Write warning and error messages.

config SETTINGS_LOG_LEVEL_INF
	bool "Info"
	help
	  Write info, warning and error messages.

config SETTINGS_LOG_LEVEL_DBG
	bool "Debug"
	help
	  Write all messages.

choice
	prompt "Settings logging level"
	default SETTINGS_LOG_LEVEL_INF
	help
	  Select the logging level for the settings subsystem.

config SETTINGS_LOG_LEVEL
	int
	default 0 if SETTINGS_LOG_LEVEL_OFF
	default 1 if SETTINGS_LOG_LEVEL_ERR
	default 2 if SETTINGS_LOG_LEVEL_WRN
	default 3 if SETTINGS_LOG_LEVEL_INF
	default 4 if SETTINGS_LOG_LEVEL_DBG
endchoice

config SETTINGS_DYNAMIC_HANDLERS
	bool "Enable dynamic settings handlers"
	help
	  This option enables settings handlers to be registered at runtime.
	  If this is disabled, all handlers must be registered at build time.

config SETTINGS_ENCODE_LEN
	bool "Store value length along with the value"
	help
	  This option enables storing value length along with the value.
	  This is useful for backends that do not store the length of the
	  value.

config SETTINGS_ENCODE_KEY
	bool "Store key along with the value"
	help
	  This option enables storing the key along with the value.
	  This is useful for backends that do not store the key.

choice SETTINGS_BACKEND
	prompt "Settings backend"
	default SETTINGS_NONE
	help
	  Select the settings backend.

config SETTINGS_NONE
	bool "No backend"
	help
	  No settings backend. Settings are not persistently stored.

config SETTINGS_FCB
	bool "Flash Circular Buffer (FCB)"
	depends on FLASH_MAP
	select FCB
	help
	  Use FCB as settings backend.

config SETTINGS_NVS
	bool "Non-volatile Storage (NVS)"
	depends on FLASH_MAP
	select NVS
	help
	  Use NVS as settings backend.

config SETTINGS_FILE
	bool "File backend"
	depends on FILE_SYSTEM
	help
	  Use a file as settings backend.

endchoice

config SETTINGS_BACKEND_NAME
	string
	default "none" if SETTINGS_NONE
	default "fcb" if SETTINGS_FCB
	default "nvs" if SETTINGS_NVS
	default "file" if SETTINGS_FILE

if SETTINGS_FCB

config SETTINGS_FCB_PARTITION
	string "FCB partition"
	default "storage_partition"
	depends on FLASH_HAS_DRIVER_ENABLED
	help
	  The name of the flash partition to use for settings. This
	  partition must be defined in the device tree.

config SETTINGS_FCB_SECTOR_COUNT
	int "Number of sectors to use"
	default 2
	help
	  Number of sectors to use for settings.

config SETTINGS_FCB_MAGIC
	hex "Magic value to use for settings records"
	default 0x1234
	help
	  Magic value to use for settings records. This is used to identify
	  valid records in the flash.

endif # SETTINGS_FCB

if SETTINGS_NVS

config SETTINGS_NVS_PARTITION
	string "NVS partition"
	default "storage_partition"
	depends on FLASH_HAS_DRIVER_ENABLED
	help
	  The name of the flash partition to use for settings. This
	  partition must be defined in the device tree.

config SETTINGS_NVS_SECTOR_COUNT
	int "Number of sectors to use"
	default 8
	help
	  Number of sectors to use for settings.

endif # SETTINGS_NVS

if SETTINGS_FILE

config SETTINGS_FILE_PATH
	string "Path to settings file"
	default "/lfs/settings.txt"
	help
	  The path to the file to use for settings.

endif # SETTINGS_FILE

endif # SETTINGS

endmenu

patch.content:
common:
  # All tests are for native_posix board, they operate on a file in /tmp
  # directory.
  platform_allow: native_posix native_posix_64
  tags: settings_file
  integration_platforms:
    - native_posix

tests:
  settings.file:
    extra_configs:
      - CONFIG_SETTINGS_FILE=y
      - CONFIG_FILE_SYSTEM=y
      - CONFIG_SETTINGS_FILE_PATH=\"/tmp/settings.txt\"

  settings.file.compress:
    extra_args: TEST_CASE=compress
    filter: not CONFIG_SETTINGS_FS_MAX_LINES
    extra_configs:
      - CONFIG_SETTINGS_COMPRESS=y
    harness_config:
      type: multi_line
      ordered: true
      regex:
        - "compress test"
        - "val8 is 8"
        - "val16 is 16"
        - "val32 is 32"
        - "val64 is 64"
        - "val_str is \"string\""
        - "val_bytes is 0102030405060708"
        - "PROJECT EXECUTION SUCCESSFUL"

  settings.file.custom_file:
    extra_args: TEST_CASE=custom_file
    extra_configs:
      - CONFIG_SETTINGS_FILE_PATH_CUSTOM=y

  settings.file.direct:
    extra_args: TEST_CASE=direct
    extra_configs:
      - CONFIG_SETTINGS_DIRECT=y

  settings.file.direct_file_ro:
    extra_args: TEST_CASE=direct_file_ro
    extra_configs:
      - CONFIG_SETTINGS_DIRECT=y
      - CONFIG_SETTINGS_FILE_READ_ONLY=y

  settings.file.max_lines:
    extra_args: TEST_CASE=max_lines
    extra_configs:
      - CONFIG_SETTINGS_FS_MAX_LINES=4
